cohort: 164 women with placenta previa who delivered at the University of Ilorin Teaching Hospital over a 5-year period (2011-2015)
finding: Advanced maternal age, grand multiparity, and being unbooked were identified as risk factors for placenta previa.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 29.3% of patients with placenta previa, while 70.7% delivered via cesarean section, and there was a significant association between the type of placenta previa and mode of delivery (P < 0.05).
gest_age: There was a significant association between gestational age at delivery and type of placenta previa (P < 0.05).
birth_weight: There was a significant association between birth weight at delivery and type of placenta previa (P < 0.05).
